Losers: none clear - dilution falls on existing Bajaj Finance holders; no listed peer is hurt by the allotment itself (PDF not readable from this sandbox, allottee and price not checked).
Catalyst: scheduled - the PI process (special committee pricing and allotment, same day) is complete; the next dated event is the 4 Dec 2026 RBI policy decision.

Thesis fit: open-queue thesis bajaj-finance-rbi-december: neutral - extra capital does not change the policy-day setup; the PI is a Bajaj-specific event before entry (entry fills after 19 Nov), worth a look under its "what would change my mind" line but not a break.
